keybindings.description: Controls and button labels share the effective bindings. Nonconflicting custom keys are preserved. Legacy bindings that conflict with required modern controls are backed up with a visible migration notice. Rebind or reset them in Settings.

modern_commands.completion: Actual camera/selection/valid preview, acknowledged queue/movement/stop, paid base completion and paid unit production are checked.
modern_commands.description: Branch selection does not launch units. Click, box or add-select units, point to preview, then right-click to move or attack. Shift queues; Stop halts a real order; Esc cancels preview or selection.
modern_commands.exercise: Practice camera, branches, selection, arrows, immediate orders, queue and stop. Complete army-base construction, training and naval-base ship movement.
modern_commands.prerequisites: Independent Regions and an owned unit. All effective keys appear in Controls; mobile uses branch and target buttons.

modern_hints.modern_air_produce: An unfinished, damaged or full base cannot produce. Wait for completion or repair; choose another base if capacity is full.
modern_hints.modern_army_train: Select an operational army base. Automatic formation uses existing army reserve first; available-personnel training must fit the mobilization cap. The pool choice and cost are shown before production.
modern_hints.modern_armybase: Choose a separate owned land tile. The price, time and base limit are in the build tooltip. Pause also pauses construction.
modern_hints.modern_box_select: Drag empty ground around a group. Shift-click a different group; Shift-clicking an already selected group does not add people.
modern_hints.modern_camera: Click the map before using keys. Text fields suppress map controls. On touch, use two fingers to pan and pinch to zoom.
modern_hints.modern_cursor: Select a living owned unit first. Choose owned land for a safe first army route; ships require connected water.
modern_hints.modern_navybase: Use your coastline where the port preview is valid. A completed port is one naval base; trade and major-port bonuses are not duplicated.
modern_hints.modern_queue: The second destination must be valid. The dashed route appears only after the core accepts it; wait for an actual completed move.

modern_steps.modern_air_intercept: Patrol near hostile aircraft with a fighter, or send a sortie near enabled enemy SAM. Wait for actual aircraft losses. Move the target inside the base radius and read the risk before ordering.
modern_steps.modern_air_launch: Choose Air {airKey} and click a fighter. Point within its base radius and right-click to patrol; a strike aircraft instead attacks an enemy target. Watch actual outbound aircraft; out-of-range targets show a reason.
modern_steps.modern_air_produce: Select the new operational air base, then produce a fighter or strike aircraft. Check the reserved cost, personnel and capacity. Wait for an actual new squadron at its base.
modern_steps.modern_air_return: Complete a short patrol, then watch Returning and Rearming. Wait for the actual return and resupply timer; no new sortie during rearming. Aircraft never capture land.
modern_steps.modern_airbase: Choose Air base in Build menu or Bases & production and right-click owned land. Check its price and press Confirm construction. Wait for completion; its capacity and health appear in the base information.
modern_steps.modern_army_move: Point to nearby owned land and right-click. The arrow becomes solid and stays while the army moves. Wait until it arrives. Against enemies, the army must actually fight and capture the ground. Touch: confirm the preview.
modern_steps.modern_army_train: In Bases & production choose your operational Army base and Train army. Cost and personnel are reserved once. Wait for the new unit to appear at the base; check the reserve and formation counts.
modern_steps.modern_armybase: Open Build menu or Bases & production. Choose Army base and right-click owned land. Check the price and press Confirm construction. Wait until its construction timer ends and the base is operational.
modern_steps.modern_box_select: Drag a box around one army group. Hold Shift and click another to add it. Selection counts must actually increase. If no second unit is visible, use {cameraKey} to find your starting groups.
modern_steps.modern_branches: Press Army {armyKey}, Navy {navyKey}, Air {airKey}, or each button below. The highlighted branch changes; this does not send units.
modern_steps.modern_camera: Use the arrow keys to move the map, then zoom with the wheel or {zoomInKey}/{zoomOutKey}. {cameraKey} returns to your units. Both a real camera move and zoom complete this step.
modern_steps.modern_cursor: With units selected, point to nearby owned land. Each unit shows a curved dotted arrow to this cursor target. Wait for the valid preview; a reason appears if the route is impossible. Touch: Target, then tap the land.
modern_steps.modern_navy_move: Choose Navy {navyKey}. In Bases & production produce a warship at an operational port and wait for its completion. Click the ship, point to nearby connected sea and right-click. Wait for actual arrival.
modern_steps.modern_navybase: Choose Naval base in Bases & production. Right-click a valid owned coastline, check its price and press Confirm construction. Wait for the Port to finish; it also keeps its normal trade role.
modern_steps.modern_population: All independent factions start with {population} people. Open Population: civilian + available + army + navy + air = living population. Reserve troops are part of army personnel, not extra people.
modern_steps.modern_queue: Right-click a nearby owned destination, then Shift-right-click another while moving. A dashed queued route follows the active solid route. Complete one real movement with an acknowledged queued order.
modern_steps.modern_select: Choose Army {armyKey}, then left-click your army icon. A selection ring and the selected count confirm selection. {selectKey} selects your visible army units. Touch: tap the icon.
modern_steps.modern_stop: Start another short move, then press {stopKey} or Stop while it is moving. Wait for the acknowledged idle state. {cancelKey} cancels preview or selection; it does not stop an active order.

modern_touch_steps.modern_air_intercept: Choose a fighter and patrol near enemy aircraft, or target near enabled enemy SAM inside your base radius. Observe real aircraft losses and the risk.
modern_touch_steps.modern_air_launch: Tap Air and a fighter. Use Target inside its base radius and Confirm order to patrol. A strike aircraft attacks an enemy target. Watch the actual outbound aircraft.
modern_touch_steps.modern_air_produce: Select an operational Air base and produce a fighter or strike aircraft. Wait for actual paid production; aircraft use personnel, capacity, gold and time.
modern_touch_steps.modern_air_return: After a short patrol, watch Returning and Rearming. Wait for actual return and resupply. Aircraft cannot capture land or launch again while rearming.
modern_touch_steps.modern_airbase: Choose Air base in Bases & production, tap owned land, check the price and Confirm construction. Wait for completion and inspect its capacity and health.
modern_touch_steps.modern_army_move: Use Target to preview nearby owned land and tap Confirm order. The solid route stays while your army actually moves. Wait for arrival; enemy land requires combat.
modern_touch_steps.modern_army_train: Choose an operational army base in Bases & production and tap Train army. Wait for the paid new unit to appear at that base.
modern_touch_steps.modern_armybase: In Bases & production choose Army base, tap valid owned land, check its price and Confirm construction. Wait until the base is operational.
modern_touch_steps.modern_box_select: Drag with one finger around one army group. Enable Add to selection, then tap another group. The actual selection count must increase.
modern_touch_steps.modern_branches: Tap Army, Navy and Air below in turn. The highlighted branch changes; selecting a branch does not launch units.
modern_touch_steps.modern_camera: Drag with two fingers to move the map, then pinch to zoom. Both a real pan and zoom complete this step.
modern_touch_steps.modern_cursor: With units selected, enable Target and tap or drag to nearby owned land. Each unit previews a curved arrow. Wait for a valid route; an impossible target explains why.
modern_touch_steps.modern_navy_move: Choose Navy, then produce a Warship at an operational port. Tap the finished ship, use Target on connected water and Confirm order. Wait for its actual arrival.
modern_touch_steps.modern_navybase: Choose Naval base in Bases & production, tap a valid owned shore and Confirm construction. Wait for the Port to finish; its trade role remains.
modern_touch_steps.modern_queue: Start a move. Enable Queue command, then Target and another valid owned destination. Confirm the preview. Wait for an acknowledged queued route and a completed real move.
modern_touch_steps.modern_select: Tap Army, then tap one of your army icons. The selection ring and count confirm selection. Select visible units selects your visible army.
modern_touch_steps.modern_stop: Start a short move, then tap Stop while it is moving. Wait for actual idle state. Cancel clears placement or selection; Stop halts an active order.

restartGame.label: Restart scenario

saveGame.description: Use the save panel; this captures the actual simulation at a tick boundary.
saveGame.label: Save game

selectAllWarships.description: Select all of your warships on the map.

shiftKey.description: Hold for additional selection, queued orders and the documented pointer actions.

input_controls.conflict: This key is used by another action
input_controls.context_help: Typing and IME suppress game commands. Modal controls take priority. Replay is read-only. Pause/speed require an allowed mode. Unassigned actions remain available through their screen controls.
input_controls.legacy_default: Legacy default replaced by modern controls
input_controls.migration: Previous bindings were backed up. Review reassigned or unassigned conflicts.
input_controls.mode_only: Available only in the stated mode
input_controls.no_game_keys: Game shortcuts are suspended in this context.

modern_v2.confirm_preview: Right-click to order; Shift-right-click adds a queued destination.
modern_v2.input_hint: Move cursor to preview · Right-click move/attack · Shift queues

reason.armybase_unavailable: Build an army base on owned land and wait for completion.
reason.base_already_exists: A base is already at this tile. Choose another owned location.
reason.base_capacity: Base capacity is full, including reserved production. Select another operational base.
reason.base_damaged_or_repairing: Repair the base or wait for its current repair to finish.
reason.base_limit: Your base limit is reached. Use or repair an existing base.
reason.base_repair_unavailable: Choose an owned damaged base that is not already repairing.
reason.base_requires_owned_land: Army and air bases need your own valid land.
reason.base_under_construction: Wait for this base or production to finish. Pause also stops its timer.
reason.faction_defeated: This faction has been defeated. Start a new scenario or review the replay.
reason.force_limit: The faction formation limit is reached. Use existing units.
reason.insufficient_army_reserve: Wait for reserve troops to accumulate, or train available personnel within the mobilization cap.
reason.insufficient_manpower: Check available personnel and the common mobilization cap. For army formations, use trained reserve troops; for new air/naval personnel, release room within the cap.
reason.mobilization_limit: Mobilization limit reached. Retrain existing reserves.
reason.navybase_disabled: Ports are disabled by this game’s rules.
reason.navybase_no_valid_site: No legal owned coastline nearby. Choose another coast away from existing structures.
reason.not_base_owner: Choose a base you currently own.
reason.warship_disabled_or_count: Warships are disabled or this production count is invalid. Use a naval-enabled scenario.
reason.warship_requires_port: Build or select an operational owned port with navigable water.

modern_v2.select_units: Left-click or drag to select; move the cursor to preview, right-click to order.

repair.base_desc_air: Build on owned land. Produce and rearm aircraft.
repair.base_desc_army: Build on owned land. Train personnel into army formations.
repair.base_desc_navy: Ports also serve as naval bases: trade, shipbuilding, docking and replenishment.
repair.base_rules: Build army and air bases on owned land, naval bases at navigable shores. Production needs an operational base, personnel, gold and time.
repair.entry_guide: Army / Navy / Air: choose a branch, select your unit, move the cursor to preview, then right-click to order. Use Bases & production to create units. Help contains every effective key.
repair.legacy_scope: Legacy v1 uses the original national AI and territorial attacks. Army/navy/air commands require Independent Regions.
repair.no_branch_units: No units in this branch. Open Bases & production to build a base and train units.
repair.place_base: {base}: right-click owned land to choose its location
repair.show_guide: Show the short command guide when starting

user_setting.keybinds_hint: Click a binding to reassign it. Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Meta combinations are supported. Conflicts are explained; bindings can be cleared or reset per mode. Controls lists every effective binding and its context.
